tools.name: status
tools.title: Workspace status
tools.description: What `craftar sync` would do in this workspace: every generated file with its state (unchanged, new, update, drift, adopt, collision, orphan, orphan-drift), the Forge it reads, warnings, and declared parameters with no value. Reads only.

tools.name: diff
tools.title: Pending differences
tools.description: Files whose content differs from what the Forge would generate. Without `path`: the list, with added and removed line counts. With `path` (workspace-relative, as `status` prints it): that file's diff. Reads only.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of one generated file, as `status` prints it

tools.name: explain
tools.title: Why a file exists
tools.description: Which ingredient, recipe chain and target produce a generated file, and which layer filled each section and parameter it cites. Reads only.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of one generated file, as `status` prints it

tools.name: recipes
tools.title: Recipes of the Forge
tools.description: Every recipe of this workspace's Forge — slot, parents, ingredients, the profiles that use it — marked against what this workspace resolves. Reads only.

tools.name: ingredients
tools.title: Ingredients of the Forge
tools.description: Every ingredient of this workspace's Forge with the recipes that bring it, marked against what this workspace resolves; optionally limited to one recipe or one ingredient type. Reads only.

recipe.description: Limit to one recipe, by name

type.description: Limit to one ingredient type (rule, agent, command, skill, mcp, …)

tools.name: targets
tools.title: Capability matrix
tools.description: What each target (claude-code, kiro, agents-md) does with each ingredient type, marking the targets this workspace uses. Reads only.

tools.name: doctor
tools.title: Workspace checks
tools.description: One finding per check about this workspace — configuration, Forge, plan, declared parameters, MCP environment variable names, the profile's templates block and dotnet, Docker Compose and the variables a service fragment expects, lock, status, registration — each with its fix. Reads only; like the command, it asks docker compose and dotnet for their version when the workspace uses them.
